programs.name: Bachelor in Hearing and Speech - Specialization in Audiology
programs.overview: Audiology is the science of studying hearing, balance and related disorders. As healthcare professionals, audiologist specialize in “prevention, identification, diagnoses, and evidence-based treatment of hearing, balance, and other auditory disorders for people of all ages” (ASHA, 2021). Utilizing different assessment techniques, audiologists reach a decision as to whether someone’s sensitivity to sound is within normal physiological levels. In contrast, if it is determined not to be so (i.e., a hearing loss is present), audiologists, through a series of meticulous testing, identify the location of the hearing loss (outer/middle/inner ears, auditory nerve, and/or central nervous system), part of hearing affected (i.e., which frequencies), the degree of the identified hearing loss (i.e., severity), and the appropriate course of action (e.g., audiological rehabilitation, referrals to other professionals, etc.). In addition, audiologists provide help to individuals with other ontological disorders such as balance and vestibular disorders, tinnitus, etc.OverviewAudiology is the science of studying hearing, balance and related disorders. programs.overview: Interior Architecture is a multi-aspects specialization that aims to study and analyze the interior environment, while taking into consideration the tangible and intangible elements to achieve the goals of the interior design. It focuses on implementing creative, functional and attractive solutions inside architecture to reach an interior environment that meets the needs and goal of users and improve their lives.

sourceNotes.text: In the Interior Architecture program, our teaching depends on practical project design implementing for the architecture and interior design concepts. Students learn how to order elements that create good designed interior spaces, and learn about shapes, areas, structures, materials, fabrics, furniture, colors and lightings. Designing process follows an organized approach of (researching, analyzing and knowledge blending) in a creative way in order to build interior spaces that achieve the project goals and customers’ needs.

Interior Architecture is a mix between Interior Design and Architecture Engineering, this is the first Program of its kind in Palestine and the second in the region.The Program is offered as a Collaboration with The Academy of Fine Arts of Verona - Italy.

programs.name: Bachelor in Social Work
programs.overview: The B.A. program in Social Work is designed to prepare students for a rewarding career in social services, providing the knowledge and skills needed to empower individuals, families, and communities. This interdisciplinary program integrates theories from psychology, sociology, public health, and law to create a comprehensive understanding of human behavior, social systems, and the challenges faced by vulnerable populations. Students will engage with core social work principles, such as social justice, ethics, and advocacy, while developing

sourceNotes.text: practical skills in areas like crisis intervention, group facilitation, and community organization.

The curriculum is built around a combination of classroom learning and hands-on experience. Through field practicums, students will have the opportunity to work with diverse populations in real-world settings, applying theoretical concepts to practice. The program covers a wide range of social work fields, including mental health, child welfare, healthcare, substance abuse, and criminal justice, equipping graduates with the flexibility to work in various sectors.

Graduates of this program will be well-prepared to pursue professional licensure, further their education with advanced degrees, or enter the workforce in roles such as case managers, counselors, community organizers, or policy advocates. With a focus on promoting social change and supporting marginalized communities, the program aims to develop compassionate, ethical, and effective social work practitioners.

programs.overview: The "Digital Media program" offered by the Faculty of Modern Media is based on a new curriculum in an ever-renewing technological media field, enabling students to acquire theoretical knowledge and practical skills to become journalists engaged in an ever-renewing digital environment. This is by making the teaching structure based on field work, providing an educational environment enhanced by laboratories dedicated to experimentation and presenting media content, and communicating with a team of academics and specialized experts.This program also focuses on everything that would provide the student with skills that would enable him/her to work independently, capable of creating media content, by enabling them to produce by themselves and create entrepreneurial pioneering projects in a world that is no longer the exclusive to large institutions.This program provides four educational fields that bring the students closer to the labor market in the field they prefer and find themselves in, so that they can choose the field of modern media technologies, digital journalism, digital photography, or digital radio and televisionOverviewThe "Digital Media program" offered by the Faculty of Modern Media is based on a new curriculum in an ever-renewing technological media field, enabling students to acquire theoretical knowledge and practical skills to become journalists engaged in an ever-renewing digital environment. programs.overview: The “Digital Media and Communication” Program that Arab American University opened will help in solving a huge problem in Palestine and the Arab World as it will be connected to the usage of 80% of citizens in the Palestinian community. The different types and forms of the social media networks and its audiences control most aspects of our lives without any deep, scientific, and practical corresponding educational programs to raise awareness, knowledge and systematic science. This program in AAUP is considered to be an innovation and renewal, and it is a scientific boldness to enter such a life and media-related field. This program depends on the field-work aspect in teaching and the university provided a scientific environment enhanced with laboratories for experiments in order to provide specialized content. Also AAUP provided an opportunity for students to contact some academics and experts face-to-face through the e-learning system as they cannot enter Palestine.This program will provide and build an interactive and integrated forum on the internet to be a platform for the program, for the faculty (Faculty of Digital Media) and for the university as well. This will be the criteria to distinguish students according to what they produce and practice, not on what they are theoretically tested in. And so students’ production will be a variety of democratic digital content that benefit the Palestinian and the Arab community.The program will provide students with the needed skills to start their own work independently and build aprofessional content, especially in light of the increasing number of unemployment between new graduates. Graduates also will be able to start their own pioneer projects in a world that is no longer exclusive to large institutions. Graduates of this program will be “Communication and Social Media Specialists” and innovators in applying technology and employing it to achieve the organization goals.This program helps to cover the gap in the educational Palestinian institutions which did not recognize the network world that forms most of our world and affects our lives.
